headline: RPG Life Sciences reports 16.5% revenue growth
hook: Trade margin caps leave RPG LS unaffected
summary: RPG Life Sciences reported revenue from operations of ₹211.6 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, marking a 16.5% increase. The company's Managing Director stated that the recent trade margin caps on drugs will not have a material impact on the business. This performance reflects the company's ability to maintain growth despite regulatory pricing pressures in the pharmaceutical sector.
why_it_matters: Regulatory pricing risks for the company appear contained for now.

headline: RPG Life Sciences reports 16.5% rise in Q2 revenue with weak margins
hook: Revenue crosses ₹200 crore on domestic growth
summary: RPG Life Sciences posted a 16.5% rise in Q2 revenue, crossing the ₹200 crore mark. Net profit declined year-on-year to ₹28.22 crore, partly impacted by a higher base from an exceptional gain of ₹11.22 crore in the same quarter last year. The company's domestic formulations business grew by 11.6%, ranking it as the fourth-fastest growing entity in the Indian pharmaceutical market. Indian retail investors tracking pharma mid-caps should note the revenue expansion despite margin compression.
why_it_matters: Topline growth continues while margins soften for RPG Life Sciences.
winners_losers: Domestic formulations business gains / margins hurt
